cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoid bone

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Does not articulate directly with another bone; suspended by muscles and ligaments.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Supports the tongue and larynx and provides attachment for suprahyoid and infrahyoid muscles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Body of hyoid bone
cards.label: 1a

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Central anterior portion between the greater cornua.
cards.label: 1a

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Greater cornu (horn) of hyoid bone
cards.label: 1b

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects posterolaterally and provides muscular and ligamentous attachment.
cards.label: 1b

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lesser cornu (horn) of hyoid bone
cards.label: 1c

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Gives attachment to the stylohyoid ligament.
cards.label: 1c

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyroid cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Largest laryngeal cartilage, formed by two laminae meeting anteriorly.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Protects the vocal apparatus and provides attachment for laryngeal muscles and ligaments.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior cornu (horn) of thyroid cartilage
cards.label: 2d

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Projects superiorly from the posterior border of the thyroid lamina toward the hyoid.
cards.label: 2d

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Inferior cornu (horn) of thyroid cartilage
cards.label: 2e

cards.question: Articulation
cards.answer: Articulates with cricoid cartilage at the cricothyroid joint.
cards.label: 2e

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricoid cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Only complete cartilaginous ring of the airway; narrow anterior arch and broad posterior lamina.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintains airway patency and supports the arytenoid cartilages.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Arytenoid cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Paired pyramidal cartilages on the cricoid lamina.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Rotate and glide to control position and tension of the vocal folds.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Vocal process anteriorly and muscular process laterally.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Corniculate cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small paired elastic cartilages sitting on the arytenoid apices.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Support the posterior aryepiglottic folds.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cuneiform cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Small paired elastic cartilages embedded in the aryepiglottic folds.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Support and stiffen the aryepiglottic folds.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Tracheal cartilage

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: C-shaped hyaline cartilage rings open posteriorly.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Maintain tracheal patency while permitting oesophageal expansion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyrohyoid ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects thyroid cartilage to hyoid bone as a thickening of the thyrohyoid membrane.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps suspend the larynx from the hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyrohyoid membrane

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Spans between the superior border of thyroid cartilage and hyoid bone.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Pierced laterally by the internal laryngeal nerve and superior laryngeal vessels.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricothyroid joint capsule

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibrous capsule surrounding the synovial cricothyroid joint.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Permits rotation and gliding that alter vocal-fold tension.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricothyroid ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects cricoid cartilage to thyroid cartilage.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Median part is used for emergency cricothyrotomy.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricotracheal ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects inferior border of cricoid cartilage to first tracheal ring.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Secures the larynx to the trachea.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Annular ligaments of trachea

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibroelastic tissue connecting adjacent tracheal rings.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Provide flexibility while maintaining continuity of the airway wall.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Membranous posterior wall of the trachea

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Fibromuscular posterior wall bridging the open ends of the C-shaped tracheal cartilages.

cards.question: Contents
cards.answer: Contains trachealis muscle and fibroelastic tissue.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows posterior wall movement and oesophageal expansion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyrohyoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Depresses hyoid or elevates larynx.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: C1 fibres travelling with the hypoglossal nerve.

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Oblique line of thyroid cartilage.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Body and greater horn of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Cricothyroid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Tenses and lengthens vocal folds, increasing pitch.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: External branch of superior laryngeal nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Anterolateral cricoid cartilage.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Inferior border and inferior horn of thyroid cartilage.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Posterior crico-arytenoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Abducts vocal folds; only intrinsic laryngeal muscle that opens the rima glottidis.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior cricoid lamina.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Muscular process of arytenoid cartilage.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Bilateral paralysis can cause critical airway obstruction.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Transverse arytenoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Adducts arytenoid cartilages and closes posterior rima glottidis.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Posterior surface of one arytenoid.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Posterior surface of opposite arytenoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Oblique arytenoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Adducts arytenoids and helps close laryngeal inlet.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Muscular process of one arytenoid.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Apex of opposite arytenoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior thyroid artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Usually first anterior branch of the external carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Descends toward superior pole of the thyroid gland.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Gives the superior laryngeal artery.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Upper thyroid gland and nearby laryngeal structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior laryngeal artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Usually a branch of the superior thyroid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Pierces the thyrohyoid membrane with the internal laryngeal nerve.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Upper laryngeal mucosa and structures.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Superior laryngeal nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Branch of the vagus nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Divides into internal and external branches near the hyoid/larynx.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: External branch supplies cricothyroid.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: Internal branch supplies sensation above the vocal folds and is important in the cough reflex.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: External branch injury causes loss of high-pitch control and voice fatigue; internal branch injury reduces supraglottic sensation and cough reflex, increasing aspiration risk.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Epiglottis

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Leaf-shaped elastic cartilage forming the anterior part of the laryngeal inlet.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect the airway during swallowing.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyo-epiglottic ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects the epiglottis to the hyoid bone.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Anchors the epiglottis superiorly/anteriorly.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Thyro-epiglottic ligament

cards.question: Attachments
cards.answer: Connects the petiole of the epiglottis to the inner thyroid cartilage.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Anchors the epiglottis inferiorly.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Laryngeal ventricle

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Recess between vestibular fold and vocal fold.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Allows independent movement of the two folds and communicates with laryngeal saccule.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vestibular fold

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold containing the vestibular ligament.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Helps protect the airway and contributes to laryngeal closure.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vocal fold (mucosa covering vocal ligament)

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosa overlying the vocal ligament and vocalis muscle.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Vibrates during phonation and closes the glottis for airway protection.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Motor control via recurrent laryngeal nerve except cricothyroid tensioning via external superior laryngeal nerve.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vocalis muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Fine-tunes tension of the vocal fold.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Recurrent laryngeal nerve (CN X).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Inner thyroid angle/anterior vocal ligament region.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Vocal process and adjacent arytenoid cartilage.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mucosa of trachea

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Respiratory mucosa lined mainly by pseudostratified ciliated columnar epithelium with goblet cells.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Warms, humidifies and clears inhaled particles via mucociliary transport.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Aryepiglottic fold

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mucosal fold from arytenoid cartilage to lateral epiglottis.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Forms the lateral boundary of the laryngeal inlet and helps close it during swallowing.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Piriform sinus

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Recess of the laryngopharynx lateral to the laryngeal inlet.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Internal laryngeal nerve lies deep to its mucosa.

cards.question: Clinical relevance
cards.answer: Foreign bodies may lodge here and injure the internal laryngeal nerve.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Apex of the tongue

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Anterior tip of the tongue.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Highly mobile part used in speech, manipulation of food and taste.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Intrinsic muscles of the tongue

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Alter the shape of the tongue: shorten, curl, flatten and narrow it.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Components
cards.answer: Superior longitudinal, inferior longitudinal, transverse and vertical muscles.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Filiform papillae

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Most numerous, slender keratinised papillae.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Provide mechanical friction; do not contain taste buds.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Fungiform papillae

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Mushroom-shaped papillae scattered especially near the apex and margins.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contain taste buds and participate in gustation.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Vallate papillae

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Large papillae arranged in a V-shaped row just anterior to the sulcus terminalis.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Contain numerous taste buds.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Taste from vallate papillae is carried by glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX), despite their anterior location.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Foramen caecum

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Small pit at apex of sulcus terminalis on dorsum of tongue.

cards.question: Embryology
cards.answer: Marks the embryological origin of the thyroglossal duct and thyroid descent.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Styloglossus muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Retracts and elevates the tongue.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Styloid process and stylohyoid ligament.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Side of tongue.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hyoglossus muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Depresses and retracts tongue.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Body and greater horn of hyoid.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Side of tongue.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Geniohyoid muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Pulls hyoid anterosuperiorly and assists mandibular depression.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: C1 fibres via hypoglossal nerve.

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Inferior mental spine of mandible.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Body of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Genioglossus muscle

cards.question: Actions
cards.answer: Protrudes tongue and depresses its central part; unilateral contraction deviates tongue to the opposite side.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII).

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Superior mental spine of mandible.

cards.question: Insertion
cards.answer: Tongue substance and body of hyoid.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Glossopharyngeal nerve (CN IX)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from the medulla.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Exits via jugular foramen and passes toward pharynx and posterior tongue.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies stylopharyngeus; carries parasympathetic secretomotor pathway to parotid.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: General sensation and taste from posterior third of tongue; afferent limb of gag reflex.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes loss of taste and sensation from posterior third of tongue, impaired afferent gag reflex, dysphagia and reduced parotid secretion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Hypoglossal nerve (CN XII)

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Arises from the hypoglossal nucleus in the medulla.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Exits through hypoglossal canal and courses forward to the tongue.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: Supplies intrinsic and extrinsic tongue muscles except palatoglossus.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: No cutaneous sensory function.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Lower motor neuron lesion causes ipsilateral tongue weakness, atrophy and fasciculations, with deviation toward the lesion on protrusion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lingual nerve

cards.question: Roots
cards.answer: Branch of mandibular division of trigeminal nerve (V3).

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes through infratemporal fossa, receives chorda tympani, then runs in floor of mouth close to submandibular duct.

cards.question: Motor functions
cards.answer: No branchial motor supply to tongue muscles.

cards.question: Sensory functions
cards.answer: General sensation from anterior two-thirds of tongue, floor of mouth and lingual gingiva; carries chorda tympani taste/parasympathetic fibres after they join it.

cards.question: Lesion
cards.answer: Causes loss of general sensation from anterior two-thirds of tongue; if injured distal to chorda tympani joining, also causes loss of taste and reduced submandibular/sublingual secretion on that side.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Lingual artery

cards.question: Origin
cards.answer: Branch of the external carotid artery.

cards.question: Course
cards.answer: Passes deep to hyoglossus and enters the tongue.

cards.question: Branches
cards.answer: Includes dorsal lingual, sublingual and deep lingual arteries.

cards.question: Supply
cards.answer: Supplies tongue and floor of mouth.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Submandibular gland

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Submandibular triangle, wrapping around posterior border of mylohyoid.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Produces mixed saliva, predominantly serous.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Submandibular duct opens at sublingual papilla beside lingual frenulum.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Parasympathetic fibres from CN VII via chorda tympani, lingual nerve and submandibular ganglion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Sublingual gland

cards.question: Location
cards.answer: Floor of mouth beneath the tongue and above mylohyoid.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Produces predominantly mucous saliva.

cards.question: Drainage
cards.answer: Multiple small ducts open along the sublingual fold; a major duct may join the submandibular duct.

cards.question: Innervation
cards.answer: Parasympathetic fibres from CN VII via chorda tympani, lingual nerve and submandibular ganglion.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Septum of the tongue

cards.question: Structure
cards.answer: Midline fibrous partition within the tongue.

cards.question: Function
cards.answer: Separates right and left tongue musculature and provides internal support.

cards.question: Identification
cards.answer: Mandible

cards.question: Articulations
cards.answer: Articulates with temporal bones at the temporomandibular joints.

cards.question: Landmarks
cards.answer: Body, ramus, angle, coronoid process, condylar process, mental and mandibular foramina.

cards.question: Relations
cards.answer: Provides attachment for several tongue and floor-of-mouth muscles.
